nodes.name: Acidification of carbon cloth
nodes.procedure: HNO3 solution (80 mL, 56%) was prepared in a 100 mL PTFE liner. Carbon cloth was cut into a 2.5 cm × 7.5 cm rectangular strip and immersed in the solution. The liner was then transferred to a hydrothermal bomb and heated at 120°C for 24 h. The resulted carbon cloth was washed using DI water until its pH value was around 6 to 7.
nodes.source_text: 4.1. Acidification of Carbon Cloth. HNO3 solution (80 mL, 56%) was prepared... until its pH value was around 6 to 7.

nodes.name: ZIF-L growth on acidified carbon cloth
nodes.procedure: Cobalt nitrate hexahydrate (0.6525 g) and 2-methylimidazole (2-MIM, 1.4625 g) were dissolved into 45 mL of DI water, separately. Right after mixing the two solutions, the acidified carbon cloth was placed into the mixed solution without stirring for 4 h. The same process was repeated for one more time; thus, the treatment time of ZIF-L is 8 h in total.
nodes.source_text: 4.2. Growth of ZIF-L-Derived CoMn-LDH on Carbon Cloth. Cobalt nitrate hexahydrate (0.6525 g) and 2-methylimidazole... treatment time of ZIF-L is 8 h in total.

nodes.name: CoMn-LDH-SO4 derivation from ZIF-L
nodes.procedure: After being washed with DI water and dried in an oven at 60°C, each sample was immersed in 80 mL aqueous solution of 10 mM MnSO4 for 6 h, with slow stirring. The synthesized samples were then washed with DI water and dried at 60°C in an oven.

nodes.name: ZIF-8 synthesis
nodes.procedure: Zinc acetate dihydrate (0.988 g) and 2-MIM (2.956 g) were dissolved in 270 mL of ethanol, separately. The 2-MIM solution was then slowly added into the zinc acetate dihydrate solution. After stirring for 10 s, the mixture was kept unstirred at room temperature for 24 h. The ZIF-8 precipitate was collected, washed, and dried at 60°C.

nodes.name: Porous carbon carbonization
nodes.procedure: Porous carbon was obtained by carbonizing ZIF-8 under a N2 atmosphere at 900°C for 8 h.
nodes.source_text: 4.4. ...Porous carbon was obtained by carbonizing ZIF-8 under a N2 atmosphere at 900°C for 8 h.

nodes.name: Anode slurry preparation
nodes.procedure: The porous carbon, carbon black, and PVDF were mixed together at a weight ratio of 7:2:1. The mixture was dispersed in ethanol and stirred overnight to make it as a slurry.

nodes.name: Anode electrode fabrication
nodes.procedure: The final product was dipped onto 1×1 cm² nickel foam and dried in an oven for 1 day.

nodes.description: Supercapacitor half-cell performance after KOH immersion
nodes.source_text: Electrochemical tests were conducted in a three-electrode setup in 1 M KOH solution for the three CoMn-LDH@carbon cloth samples, which were immersed in KOH for 30 min in advance... The areal capacity is calculated from the discharge curve as 582.07 mC/cm² for CoMn-LDH-SO₄ at 2 mA/cm²... Upon 5000 charge-discharge cycles at 10 mA/cm², the capacity of CoMn-LDH SO₄ can well be maintained at 77% of its initial value

nodes.description: Supercapacitor half-cell performance after KOH immersion
nodes.source_text: Its rate capability (66.2%) is also higher than the other two samples (56.6% and 54.9%)... Although around 90% of the initial value can be maintained for the other two samples, their capacity stays at around 200 mC/cm², which is still 2 times lower than the capacity of CoMn-LDH-SO₄ after 5000 charge-discharge cycles

nodes.description: Hybrid supercapacitor full cell performance with porous carbon
nodes.source_text: The full cell test was conducted using a two-electrode configuration in 1.0 M KOH solution... The capacitance was calculated to be 308.48 mF/cm² at 2 mA/cm², and the energy density is 0.096 mWh/cm² with a power density of 1.5 mW/cm²... During the repeating charge-discharge test at 10 mA/cm², the capacitance can well maintain at 89% of the initial value after 18,000 charge-discharge cycles

nodes.characterization_summary: CoMn-LDH-SO₄ shows more interconnected hydroxide sheets. CoMn-LDH-NO₃ and CoMn-LDH-Cl show compact morphology with hydroxide sheets laid on the surface.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Among the three samples, CoMn-LDH-SO₄ shows more interconnected hydroxide sheets. As for the other two samples, the hydroxide sheets are laid on the surface and show a compact morphology.

properties.description: Nanofiber morphology with fibrous, web-like structure

nodes.characterization_summary: CoMn-LDH-SO₄ sheets small and interconnected; CoMn-LDH-NO₃/Cl sheets larger and planar. SAED shows typical LDH pattern with extra circles from hydroxide decomposition.
nodes.evidence_snippet: TEM studies (see Figure 2d-f) show that the CoMn-LDH SO₄ sheets were small and interconnected with each other, while CoMn-LDH-NO₃/Cl sheets prefer to be in one plane and the sizes are larger. The SAED images show a typical pattern for LDH.

nodes.characterization_summary: Lattice fringes show (006) plane spacing ~0.5 nm for CoMn-LDH-SO₄, confirmed by FFT image. Clear fringes indicate good crystallinity.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The enlarged TEM images (Figure 2g-i) present the lattice fringes of the (006) plane in each sample, showing a larger interlayer spacing of around 0.5 nm for CoMn-LDH-SO₄, which also can be confirmed by the FFT image.

nodes.characterization_summary: BET surface areas are 89.4 m²/g for CoMn-LDH-SO₄, 65.6 m²/g for CoMn-LDH-NO₃, and 72.6 m²/g for CoMn-LDH-Cl.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The BET surface areas of CoMn-LDH-SO₄, CoMn-LDH-NO₃, and CoMn-LDH-Cl are 89.4, 65.6, 72.6 m²/g, respectively...

nodes.characterization_summary: CoMn-LDH-SO₄: glaucocerinite (PDF 39-0726), (003) d=1.08 nm. CoMn-LDH-NO₃: quintinite (PDF 51-1526), d=0.76 nm. CoMn-LDH-Cl: quintinite, d=0.78 nm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: CoMn-LDH SO₄ exhibits a glaucocerinite group structure (PDF no. 39-0726), and CoMn-LDH-NO₃ and CoMn-LDH-Cl exhibit a quintinite group structure (PDF no. 51-1526). Among the three samples, CoMn-LDH-SO₄ has the largest (003) plane distance of 1.08 nm...

nodes.characterization_summary: S, N, Cl detected in respective samples at 1.6-1.8 at%. Mn:Co ratios are 1:2.12, 1:2.09, 1:2.10 for SO₄, NO₃, Cl samples.
nodes.evidence_snippet: EDX studies (see Figure S4a) for the samples derived from 6 h of reaction show the existence of S, N, and Cl in the respective samples, where the atomic ratio of this inserted anion is around 1.6-1.8 at %.

nodes.characterization_summary: SO₄ groups detected in CoMn-LDH-SO₄. CO₃²⁻ detected in all samples from dissolved CO₂.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The FTIR measurement (see Figure S4b) also demonstrates the existence of SO₄ groups in CoMn-LDH-SO₄. In addition, CO₃²⁻ is also detected in all three samples...

nodes.characterization_summary: Mn 3s splitting 5.3-6.0 eV indicates Mn³⁺. Co 2p satellite peaks match Co(OH)₂ indicating Co²⁺. High-resolution spectra confirm SO₄²⁻, NO₃⁻, Cl⁻ anions.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The respective XPS spectra (Figure 3b,c) show the energy split for Mn 3s peaks being around 5.3 to 6.0 eV for all three samples, indicating Mn exists mainly in the 3+ oxidation state. The Co 2p XPS spectra contain clear satellite peaks, and they are similar to Co(OH)₂ peaks...

properties.peaks: Multiple peaks observed around 780-800 eV region

properties.description: X-ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy data

nodes.characterization_summary: After 30 min in 1M KOH: CoMn-LDH-SO₄ → brucite (PDF 01-0357, retains layered); CoMn-LDH-NO₃/Cl → MnCo₂O₄ spinel (PDF 23-1237, loses layered structure).
nodes.evidence_snippet: Upon immersing in KOH, CoMn-LDH-SO₄ changed from the glaucocerinite to brucite structure (PDF no. 01-0357) but retaining the layered structure, while both CoMn-LDH-NO₃ and CoMn-LDH-Cl changed from the quintinite to MnCo₂O₄ spinel phase (PDF no. 23-1237)...

nodes.characterization_summary: After KOH immersion: S content decreases but persists in CoMn-LDH-SO₄; N/Cl signals disappear. Mn 3s FWHM increases for NO₃/Cl indicating Mn³⁺ disproportionation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The XPS results show that the contents of S, N, and Cl have dramatically decreased in three samples (see Figure S5). The signals for N 1s and Cl 2p disappear, but the S 2p still has a small signal.
